'''Orto''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Orto system/Legends|Orto system]] of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] race.

==Description==
Orto was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Orto system/Legends|of the same name]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a small, [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a highly elliptical [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]]. [[Water/Legends|Water]] was plentiful on Orto, though much of it was frozen in the form of [[Water/Legends|snow]] and ice, and its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was thin, but rich in [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Beneath its ice caps, the world also possessed an abundant supply of heavy metals and [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuels]]. Due to its orbit, axial tilt, and atmospheric conditions, Orto's [[growing season]] lasted an average of 161 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] and occurred only in latitudes near the equator,<ref name="GG4" /> and as a result of these harsh conditions, [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] was scarce and famines were common. The [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to Orto, were efficient [[Miner/Legends|miners]], and as their economy was barter-based, manufacturing companies competed for the planet's [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] by importing the best or most exotic foodstuffs possible.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
[[Geologist/Legends|Geologists]] believed that Orto had been struck by a large [[Comet/Legends|comet]] or planetary body in the past and hypothesized that the collision was the cause of Orto's peculiar orbit. In any case, Orto's climate was altered by a disaster at some point and all lifeforms over 200 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] in mass were driven to extinction by freezing temperatures and lack of food. With their primary predators gone, the primitive Ortolans, who were small enough to survive, were left as the planet's dominant species.<ref name="GG4" />

[[File:OrtolansCW.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Ortolan civilians, including Nem Bees (far left), huddle in a street as battle droids march through the capital.]]
Orto was neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] until its [[Financial Minister]], [[Belo Tusus]], declared his allegiance to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], seized control of the planetary government, and locked down all [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Later that day, Confederate forces arrived on Orto and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stormed its capital. While Tusus worked to settle his new government, it was struck by several unexplained acts of sabotage. These attacks were committed by [[Nem Bees]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] under cover as a common Ortolan citizen. Bees later reestablished contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], arranging for a battalion of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to arrive in-system at a designated time shortly before infiltrating Tusus's palace to disable its [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. When the Republic forces arrived, Tusus, fearing for his life, fled Orto, and Bees rendezvoused with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Deviss/Legends|Deviss]]. One [[Standard week/Legends|week]] into their [[Battle of Orto|campaign]] to remove the entrenched droid armies, [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, and Deviss cut down Bees as he led an assault on enemy lines.<ref name="DB" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Orto was largely left alone by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Although the Empire did impose regulations limiting the natives' ability to leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="UAA" /> supposedly for their own protection,<ref name="GG4" /> as long as they traded their ore to Imperial supporters such as [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], the Empire remained indifferent to them.<ref name="UAA" /> To facilitate the extraction of resources, the Empire established several large processing centers on Orto.<ref name="GG4" /> The Ortolans also traded with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and altogether, the war was a boon to Orto's food supply.<ref name="UAA" />

==Locations==
At least one city existed on Orto, functioning as the planet's capital. The world also hosted multiple spaceports,<ref name="DB" /> as well as several processing stations which had been established under Imperial rule. A massive crater was buried beneath the northern polar ice cap of Orto.<ref name="GG4" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sluis sector and, consequently, Orto, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
